videos.title: Rise of the Whoop dupes | The Vergecast
videos.description:
For the last few years, the trend in wearables has been all about screens. As many of them as possible. But now, companies like Whoop, Fitbit, and Garmin are creating new products that ditch the display entirely. The Verge's Victoria Song explains why no-screen is the new flex, why even the most quantified athletes might not want a display on their wrist, and whether Whoop and the Whoop Dupes are a sign of a broader trend.

videos.description:
One tiny dock to rule them all? The $90 Sharge Disk Pro 2 Ultra is a magnetic USB-C hub that doubles as a Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 dock and triples as an SSD and quadruples as speedy ProRes storage for an iPhone. You do have to bring your own SSD and sometimes extra USB-C power, but it's much improved over previous Sharge models! It's currently on Kickstarter with deliveries estimated for October 2026.

videos.title: Meta's Oversight Board is coming for ChatGPT and Claude | The Vergecast
videos.description:
A new study from the Oversight Board found that leading AI systems are less likely to criticize authoritarian governments than democratic ones. It's a wild finding — but wait? Why is the Oversight Board studying systems from OpenAI and Anthropic in the first place? Suzanne Nossel, who sits on the board, joined us to discuss the findings and why the Oversight Board's future might involve looking at more than just Meta.
